finding: Catalog tracing found multiple Ma'ani al-Qur'an records, so KSU's bare citation '(377)' cannot yet be assigned to one edition. The National Library of Tunisia catalogs a Cairo 1955 two-volume edition edited by Ahmad Yusuf Najati and Muhammad Ali al-Najjar; a UAE catalog records a 1989 two-volume Dar al-Surur edition by the same editors; Quranpedia labels a first-edition one-volume Dar al-Misriyya text edited by Najati alone and says it follows print. IslamWeb's readable passage is volume 3, displayed p. 296, with poem opening ها أنت; KSU note says p. 377 and هل أنت. These are plausible pagination/edition pathways, not proof which KSU cites; no p. 377 scan obtained.
